snippet.title: Theralite Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Theralite - Turn based Sci-fi Roguelike

A Turn based Sci-fi Roguelike where players explore the deep mines on a distant planet, find/trade equipment, battle monsters and try to survive. Easy to pick up and play but challenging. Hand crafted Pixel art and Permadeath!

Check it out now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445690/Theralite/

Dual Bitz 2026.
